note: Re-judged 2026-11-25 after unifying next-hop self/unchanged into the export filter chain (setExportNextHopSelf / setExportNextHopUnchanged, replacing deleted PeerSettings.NextHopMode). Read RFC 4271 Section 5.1.3 verbatim ("A BGP speaker MUST be able to support the disabling advertisement of third party NEXT_HOP attributes in order to handle imperfectly bridged media."). Q1-Q4: Positive units TestRFC4271ThirdPartyNextHopCanBeDisabled, TestRFC4271NextHopSelfDisablesThirdPartyNextHopOnTheWire, and TestRFC4271NextHopSelfWithAutoLocalAddressSendsTheConnectedEndpoint prove that enabling next-hop:self arms nhModeSelf4 and rewrites third-party NEXT_HOP to the speaker's configured or connected local endpoint on both general and route-server rails while default/unchanged peers preserve the third-party NEXT_HOP. Negative units TestRFC4271ThirdPartyNextHopDisableFailsClosed and TestRFC4271NextHopSelfWithNoLocalAddressWithholdsTheRoute prove fail-closed withholding (nhSelfWithheld + ErrNextHopSelfNoLocal) when no usable local address exists. All five units carry current observed discrimination records.
